description: Per-service onboarding checklists loaded by FMOS when a new client is created. Triggered automatically after agreement confirmation is logged. Each service has its own checklist. If a client signs for multiple services, all relevant checklists are merged into one onboarding task list in FMOS.
triggeredBy: Agreement status changes to CONFIRMED in FMOS
assignedTo: Jabeer (all onboarding tasks default to Jabeer — he delegates to team as appropriate)

onboarding_flow.step1: Agreement confirmed → FMOS creates onboarding task list for the client
onboarding_flow.step2: Jabeer sends welcome message to client via WhatsApp (template: ONBOARD_WELCOME)
onboarding_flow.step3: Jabeer works through asset collection checklist (WhatsApp or meeting)
onboarding_flow.step4: All assets stored in client's Asset Vault in FMOS
onboarding_flow.step5: Setup tasks assigned to team (Zaid/Sufiyan for websites, Jabeer for everything else)
onboarding_flow.step6: First delivery milestone logged in FMOS
onboarding_flow.step7: Onboarding marked COMPLETE — client status changes to ACTIVE

WEBSITE.label: Website Building
WEBSITE.onboardingTimeTarget: Complete asset collection within 3 days of agreement. Site live within 10–14 working days.

jabeerActions.task: Send welcome message to client
Share Website Brief Form link with client (or fill it together on a call)
jabeerActions.notes: Brief form is the single most important onboarding step for websites. Everything the cousins build comes from this.

jabeerActions.task: Collect domain login credentials from client
Collect hosting login credentials from client (or set up Hostinger if needed)
Review completed Brief Form before assigning to cousins
jabeerActions.notes: Do not assign to Zaid/Sufiyan until brief is complete and reviewed.

jabeerActions.task: Create website build task in FMOS — assign to Zaid or Sufiyan
Review Stage 1 (structure/layout) submitted by cousin
Review final website before client preview
Get written client approval before going live
jabeerActions.notes: Send preview link. Client confirms via WhatsApp. Log confirmation in FMOS.

jabeerActions.task: Go live — point domain to hosting, final checks
Connect Google Analytics and Google Search Console
Mark onboarding complete in FMOS. Client status → ACTIVE.

assetsToCollect.format: PNG with transparent background (preferred) or SVG
Hex codes or just confirm from logo
JPG/PNG — interior, exterior, team, services in action. Minimum 10 photos.
assetsToCollect.notes: If client has no photos, advise them to take on phone. WhatsApp over is fine.

assetsToCollect.format: WhatsApp message or typed list is fine
Username + password for registrar (GoDaddy, Hostinger, etc.)
cPanel / Hostinger login
Submitted via the Brief Form app in FMOS
Old website text, brochures, PDFs — anything the client already has

teamTasks.task: Build website as per Brief Form and Jabeer's assigned prompts
teamTasks.submitVia: FMOS task update with preview link

GMB.label: GMB Optimization
GMB.onboardingTimeTarget: Full access and setup complete within 2 days. First optimization actions within 5 days.

jabeerActions.task: Send welcome message to client
Request Google Business Profile access from client (send invite from FortuneMarq Google account)
jabeerActions.notes: Ask client to accept the manager invite from Google. Send them a step-by-step if needed.

jabeerActions.task: Audit current GMB profile — note what's missing or wrong
Collect business photos from client
Update GMB — categories, description, services, hours, photos, Q&A
Log GMB baseline metrics in FMOS (views, calls, direction requests)
jabeerActions.notes: Screenshot from GMB dashboard. This is the benchmark for Month 1 report.

jabeerActions.task: Mark onboarding complete. Client status → ACTIVE.

assetsToCollect.format: Manager invite accepted by client
Interior, exterior, team, products/services. Minimum 10.
WhatsApp message listing days and times
WhatsApp message or typed list
Full address with pincode

SEO.label: SEO
SEO.onboardingTimeTarget: All access granted within 3 days. Technical audit complete within 7 days.

jabeerActions.task: Send welcome message to client
Request website backend access from client
Request Google Search Console access — add FortuneMarq Google account as owner/full user
jabeerActions.notes: If client has no GSC set up, create and verify it. Property type: domain.

jabeerActions.task: Request Google Analytics access — add FortuneMarq Google account as Editor
jabeerActions.notes: If client has no GA4, set it up and install tracking code on website.

jabeerActions.task: Run full technical SEO audit
jabeerActions.notes: Check: page speed, mobile usability, crawl errors, broken links, meta tags, heading structure, local SEO signals.

jabeerActions.task: Log baseline keyword rankings in FMOS
jabeerActions.notes: Track 5–15 keywords depending on SEO tier. These are the Month 1 benchmark.

jabeerActions.task: Create Month 1 SEO action plan — share with client
Mark onboarding complete. Client status → ACTIVE.

assetsToCollect.format: CMS login (WordPress, Wix, etc.) or Antigravity access
Full user / owner access granted to FortuneMarq Google account
Editor access granted to FortuneMarq Google account
WhatsApp — just ask 'What do you want to rank for?' in simple language
assetsToCollect.notes: FortuneMarq leads the keyword strategy. This is just directional input from the client.

GOOGLE_ADS.label: Google Ads Management
GOOGLE_ADS.onboardingTimeTarget: All access granted within 3 days. Campaigns live within 7 days.

jabeerActions.task: Send welcome message to client
Request Google Ads account access — or create one for the client
jabeerActions.notes: If creating new account: use client's Google account, not FortuneMarq's. The account must belong to the client.

jabeerActions.task: Confirm monthly ad budget with client in writing (WhatsApp message)
jabeerActions.notes: Log the confirmed budget in FMOS client profile. This is the reference if any budget dispute arises.

jabeerActions.task: Confirm the landing page / website URL the ads will send traffic to
jabeerActions.notes: Ads cannot run effectively without a strong landing page. If client has no website, recommend Website service first.

jabeerActions.task: Set up billing on the Google Ads account (client's own payment method)
jabeerActions.notes: Guide client to add their card/UPI. FortuneMarq must not be added as billing contact.

jabeerActions.task: Build campaign structure, keyword list, ad copy. Share for Jabeer review before launch.
Launch campaigns. Log launch date in FMOS.
Send launch confirmation to client with what to expect in Week 1
Mark onboarding complete. Client status → ACTIVE.

assetsToCollect.format: Admin access granted to FortuneMarq Google Ads manager account
Written confirmation via WhatsApp
URL link

assetsToCollect.asset: Phone number to use in ads
assetsToCollect.format: Mobile number — must be reachable during business hours

META_ADS.label: Meta Ads Management
META_ADS.onboardingTimeTarget: All access granted within 3 days. Campaigns live within 7 days.

jabeerActions.task: Send welcome message to client
Request Facebook Page admin access
jabeerActions.notes: Client must add FortuneMarq's Facebook account as Page admin. Send them a step-by-step if needed.

jabeerActions.task: Request Meta Business Manager access — or create one for the client
jabeerActions.notes: Client's Business Manager must own the ad account. FortuneMarq is added as a partner agency.

jabeerActions.task: Confirm monthly ad budget with client in writing (WhatsApp message)
Collect brand photos / videos for ad creatives
Set up Meta Pixel on client's website (if applicable)
Build campaign — audiences, creatives, ad copy. Review before launch.
Launch campaigns. Log launch date in FMOS.
Send launch confirmation to client with what to expect in Week 1–2
Mark onboarding complete. Client status → ACTIVE.

assetsToCollect.format: Admin role granted to FortuneMarq Facebook account
Partner access for FortuneMarq
Written confirmation via WhatsApp

assetsToCollect.asset: Brand photos or videos for creatives
assetsToCollect.format: JPG/PNG (1080x1080 or higher) or MP4 (under 30 seconds). WhatsApp is fine.
Connected to Facebook Page. FortuneMarq added via Business Manager.

WHATSAPP_MARKETING.label: WhatsApp Marketing
WHATSAPP_MARKETING.onboardingTimeTarget: API setup and template submission within 5 days. First campaign within 14 days.

jabeerActions.task: Send welcome message to client
Confirm the dedicated phone number for WhatsApp API
jabeerActions.notes: This number must NOT be registered with personal WhatsApp. It gets migrated to WhatsApp Business API. If client doesn't have one, advise getting a new SIM.

jabeerActions.task: Request Meta Business Manager access to set up WhatsApp Business API
Set up WhatsApp Business API on the client's phone number
Submit 3–5 message templates for Meta approval
jabeerActions.notes: Templates take 1–3 days to approve. Submit early.

jabeerActions.task: Collect client's customer contact list
jabeerActions.notes: CSV format with name + phone number. Must be opt-in contacts only.

jabeerActions.task: Once templates approved — run first test broadcast to 5–10 numbers
Launch first full broadcast campaign
Mark onboarding complete. Client status → ACTIVE.

assetsToCollect.asset: Dedicated phone number for WhatsApp API
assetsToCollect.format: Mobile number (not registered with personal WhatsApp)
Partner access for FortuneMarq
CSV or Excel — Name, Phone Number columns. Opt-in contacts only.

AI_AUTOMATIONS.label: AI Automations
AI_AUTOMATIONS.onboardingTimeTarget: Discovery session within 3 days. First automation deployed within 14–21 days.

jabeerActions.task: Send welcome message to client
Book and run 30–45 minute discovery session with client
jabeerActions.notes: Goal: understand their current workflow, identify the 2–3 highest-impact automation opportunities. Log notes in FMOS.

jabeerActions.task: Define automation scope — confirm with client in writing
jabeerActions.notes: Send a short WhatsApp summary: 'Here's what we'll build: [list]. Confirm to start.' Client confirms by reply.

jabeerActions.task: Request access to all third-party tools needed
Build Automation 1 (highest priority from discovery)
Test automation with client — get feedback
Apply feedback and deploy Automation 1 live
Provide documentation: how the automation works, what to do if it fails
Mark onboarding complete. Client status → ACTIVE.

assetsToCollect.asset: Access to all tools the automation will connect
assetsToCollect.format: Login credentials or API keys for each tool (CRM, calendar, WhatsApp, etc.)
Logged in FMOS by Jabeer during/after the session
Client's WhatsApp reply confirming the scope summary
